open_decisions.question: Which character encoding do the DISPLAY files of this batch use (assumed EBCDIC code page 037), and must Java preserve EBCDIC collation for indexed keys such as PORT-KEY, VSAM-RECORD-KEY, POS-KEY and TRAN-KEY?

Which character encoding (code page) do the files and areas described by these copybooks use for DISPLAY data on the legacy platform (EBCDIC 037, 1140, another EBCDIC variant, or ASCII)? The zoned-decimal test vectors and String codecs depend on it.

Contradiction CON-PKT0004-001 (BR-149, GAP-212): copybook PORTFLIO declares portfolio status 'PORT-STATUS 88 PORT-ACTIVE 'A' / PORT-CLOSED 'C' / PORT-SUSPENDED 'S'', while PORTMSTR validates A / I / C (BR-095). PORTUPDT action 'S' moves the new value into PORT-STATUS without validation. Which portfolio status set is authoritative, and must a status maintenance update be validated against it?

GAP-077: (1) EVALUATE TRUE on UPDT-ACTION (line 132) has no WHEN OTHER, so an unknown action code changes no field but the record is still rewritten and counted as updated; (2) MOVE UPDT-NEW-VALUE X(50) TO WS-NUMERIC-WORK S9(13)V99 (line 138) gives a result that depends on the input content; (3) on OPEN failure 3000-TERMINATE returns (line 105) and the loop still runs. For each point: should the forward maintenance reject unknown action codes, define how a 'V' value is parsed and rejected when not numeric, and stop after an open failure, or reproduce the as-found behaviour?
